hook: SNL put Altman, Musk, Zuckerberg and Amodei in a *CIA class on spotting spies*
caption:
SNL opened its November 14 show with John Mulaney as a CIA officer briefing AI's biggest names on how to tell a real admirer from a spy.
The cast played Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, Dario Amodei and Peter Thiel.
Then Bowen Yang returned to the show as Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia CEO after admitting an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

Who did SNL nail best?
